object_description: zigzagging building volume stepped into a hillside
design_condition: The building is set into the sloping hillside in niches, aligning its cornice with the existing school while expanding outdoor space toward the bottom of the plot.

positive.statement: The project offers remarkable coherence at all scales, from site insertion to constructive detail.
The building takes advantage of the topography rather than entering into conflict with it.
The garden becomes a functional, efficient and fluid connecting space and a public outdoor area.
The program fits convincingly on the different levels, with fluid circulation spaces benefiting from views and lateral natural lighting.
The architectural expression is subtle and discreet, with a marked horizontality and a distinct identity.
The implementation resolves most of the site's integration difficulties with very good spatial qualities.

negative.statement: The landscaping of the garden is still a little basic and could be deepened into a neighborhood-scale public space.
The English-courtyard device is somewhat boxy and deserves to be optimized.
Accessibility for people with reduced mobility is not currently guaranteed at the bottom of the auditoriums.
The east and south facades, which were not shown, must be checked.
